newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Treasurer opposes new GASB guidelines.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Treasurer opposes new GASB guidelines.

text.p: California State Treasurer Matt Fong on Thursday urged municipal finance professionals to oppose a proposed rule for financial reporting by local government investment pools.

Fong said government pools should not have to include unrealized mark-to-market figures in the income statements of their operating documents as proposed by the Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB). He spoke at a Bond Buyer Newspaper conference on public finance in California.
GASB has pushed forward with the proposal despite opposition by some municipal groups. GASB could approve the guidelines as early as its December meeting.
Fong said local governments should instead provide the information on changes in market value in footnotes to their financial statements.
The California Treasurer warned the GASB proposal could hurt local governments because municipalities could be forced to incorporate the unrealized pool gains and losses into their budget plans.
"This will give a distorted appearance," Fong said. "It could cost taxpayers money."
